description: This Java class 'CloseGSIMCommandHandler' handles commands to close a GSIM account within the Fineract platform. It implements the 'NewCommandSourceHandler' interface, is annotated as a Spring Service and CommandType, and delegates the processing to the 'SavingsAccountWritePlatformService'.

classes.name: CloseGSIMCommandHandler
classes.description: Handles the close GSIM account command, implementing the NewCommandSourceHandler interface and delegating the actual close operation to the savings account write platform service.

methods.name: CloseGSIMCommandHandler
methods.description: Constructor that injects the SavingsAccountWritePlatformService dependency.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the close GSIM command by invoking the bulkGSIMClose method on the savings account write platform service.
